about: Skymark F-1, Sector 6, Noida. Source: the Blender exterior our builder saves (blender -b -P scripts/skymark/blender/exterior.py -- --save build/skymark.blend --context build/context_raw.glb). Frame: x along the footprint's long axis, y across, metres; the street front is the -y face.

city.about: scripts/world/prep.py <skydata> build/noida/scene.json build/noida/world.json --region scripts/world/regions/noida-skymark.json. hero_xy is Skymark's footprint centroid in that scene; rot_deg turns the scene's east/north into this frame (-phi of exterior.py's frame.json).
